# BazaarForge

> BazaarForge is a small Shopify Partner studio behind Smart Collection Pro (SCP).
> SCP is a Shopify app that builds and maintains product collections automatically from custom rules, at scale up to catalogs of a million products.

This file lists links to our documentation and site pages, following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Pages

- [Affiliate Program](https://bazaarforge.com/affiliates/): Recommend Smart Collection Pro to merchants and earn a lifetime revenue share, starting at 20% and climbing to 35% as your referred MRR grows.
- [Where AI Fits In](https://bazaarforge.com/ai/): BazaarForge's AI manifesto — we use AI to build faster, but engineering stays at the center and every line gets reviewed.
- [Contact](https://bazaarforge.com/contact/): How to reach BazaarForge: email, office hours (Prague/CET), response time, and the languages we answer in.
- [Custom Apps](https://bazaarforge.com/custom-apps/): Custom Shopify apps for automation and data at real volume: logic Shopify Flow can't run, reacting the moment your catalog or orders change.
